reason: Both satisfy all hard requirements, but Response B's four-phase design is more realistic and operationally specific: it isolates high-complexity/enterprise accounts into their own final phase with wave-based sub-batching, gives a more quantified halt-metric set (including a support-ticket threshold and a 4-hour rollback SLA), and its risk mitigations (idempotent charge keys, cent-level tax variance alerting) are more concrete and actionable than Response A's.
